description: Header file defining the VideoDecoder class for Android shared video decoding, including class declarations, member variables, and method signatures related to video decoding functionality within the Starboard platform.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for Android shared video decoding, managing codec initialization, input/output buffers, format changes, and rendering within the Starboard platform.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the VideoDecoder with video stream info, DRM, output mode, capabilities, and configuration options.

methods.name: ~VideoDecoder
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources.

methods.name: GetSink
methods.description: Returns a scoped reference to the video renderer sink.

methods.name: GetRenderAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns a unique pointer to the video render algorithm.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames.

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the preroll timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of cached frames (fixed at 12).

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTargetSizeAndContentRegion_Locked
methods.description: Updates decode target size and content region under lock.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: OnNewTextureAvailable
methods.description: Callback when a new texture is available.

methods.name: is_decoder_created
methods.description: Checks if the media decoder has been created.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Attempts to initialize the media codec, returns success status.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Cleans up codec resources.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffersInternal
methods.description: Internal method to process input buffers.

methods.name: ProcessOutputBuffer
methods.description: Handles output buffer processing.

methods.name: OnEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Handles end of stream signaling.

methods.name: RefreshOutputFormat
methods.description: Refreshes output format information.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Performs periodic decoder tasks.

methods.name: OnFlushing
methods.description: Handles flushing state.

methods.name: TryToSignalPrerollForTunnelMode
methods.description: Signals preroll in tunnel mode.

methods.name: IsFrameRenderedCallbackEnabled
methods.description: Checks if frame rendered callback is enabled.

methods.name: OnFrameRendered
methods.description: Callback when a frame is rendered.

methods.name: OnTunnelModePrerollTimeout
methods.description: Handles tunnel mode preroll timeout.

methods.name: OnTunnelModeCheckForNeedMoreInput
methods.description: Checks if more input is needed in tunnel mode.

methods.name: OnVideoFrameRelease
methods.description: Handles video frame release.

methods.name: OnSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles surface destruction event.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error with error code and message.
